A single ultra-detailed cyberpunk pop-art poster fills the frame with a metallic, futuristic female protagonist in a dense neon city setting. The style is highly artistic, graphic, and poster-like, combining comic-book linework, pop-art color blocking, chrome reflections, and cyberpunk lighting. The palette is dominated by saturated magenta, hot pink, cyan, electric blue, black, silver, and warm orange accents. The composition is vertical and tightly packed, with the woman occupying the right half and oversized typography dominating the left half.

On the upper-left side, large stacked headline lettering appears in thick block forms with distressed texture, dark shadows, and metallic highlights. The top line reads "CYBERPUNK" in bright pink and silver, followed below by "FUTURE" in pale blue-gray, then "IS NOW" in white and gray, and lower down "LIVE" in bold yellow-orange letters. Beneath this headline block, smaller stacked text reads "NOT TOMORROW", set in compact uppercase type with a weathered printed texture. The typography has heavy outlines, beveled edges, worn speckling, and a three-dimensional signboard quality, making it feel like part of the neon city environment.

Across the central-left area, a large circular neon sign sits behind the woman’s head and shoulder. It glows in concentric rings of pink, red, orange, and yellow, with radial burst lines extending outward. Inside the circle, a stylized female profile illustration appears in pale cream and pink tones, framed by angular starburst shapes. Below the circle, a rectangular neon billboard contains a small portrait of an androgynous figure wearing sunglasses and a dark jacket, rendered in sharp black-and-white comic shading. Nearby, another rectangular sign shows a dark mask-like face or helmet shape against a pale background, adding to the layered advertising-board atmosphere.

The main woman is shown from the chest upward on the right side, angled slightly toward the viewer while looking off to the right with a calm, serious expression. She appears as a young adult East Asian woman with smooth light-to-medium skin, an oval face, defined cheekbones, full lips, and almond-shaped eyes. Her makeup is dramatic and polished: dark eyeliner, long lashes, warm eyeshadow, sculpted brows, subtle blush, and glossy rose-toned lipstick. Her hair is black, wet-looking, tousled, and pulled back loosely, with strands catching blue and magenta highlights. A metallic cybernetic headset wraps around her

Style: cinematic-realistic with flat-poster design sensibility. A premium Chinese festival poster fills the frame, using a Song-dynasty-inspired new Chinese aesthetic, meticulous fine-line illustration, layered mist, frosted grain texture, and a saturated gold-brown-red gradient palette. The upper-left text block is large, thin, serif, and vertically stacked in feeling despite horizontal lettering, with the main English title reading "CHINESE TRADITIONAL FESTIVALS". Directly below it, the larger Chinese headline reads "中秋国庆", followed by the smaller subtitle "月照山河 盛世同庆". Behind the typography, an enormous full moon dominates the background, occupying most of the right and central area; its edge is softly blurred, its surface shows crater-like mottling, and its warm cream-gold glow diffuses into the red-orange sky. Layered mountain silhouettes stretch across the moon and horizon, creating depth through atmospheric haze and dark ink-wash contours. In the lower middle, a small rabbit stands on a rocky peak, facing the moon, rendered as a delicate white silhouette with fine linework. Around it are traditional landscape elements including distant temples with upturned eaves, winding rivers or valleys, rolling hills, translucent clouds, and ornamental scrollwork patterns. The entire image has a printed poster texture with visible grain, soft gradients, high contrast shadowing, and refined decorative detail. At the lower-left date area, the large serif numerals read "10.01", then "10.08", with "2026" placed between them as a year marker. Beneath the dates, small uppercase serif text reads "MID AUTUMN FESTIVAL NATIONAL DAY". Along the bottom-left margin, very small horizontal text reads "MID AUTUMN FESTIVAL", and near the lower-left edge another tiny line reads "Oct 1 - Oct 06, 2026". In the bottom-right corner, very small uppercase serif text reads "NATIONAL DAY". The composition remains poster-like and typographic, with all text fixed in place, clean, legible, and not distorted.

中秋佳节平面插画，海报设计，高级感排版，新中式美学，中国当代艺术风格，新中式宋代主题，国风美学，工笔画，层次感，弥散渐变，细节满满，渐变和肌理磨砂处理，造型柔和，高饱和金棕红渐变背景，超大满月居于画面后方占据大半画幅，满月边缘柔和虚化，月亮后方连绵宋式山水山河剪影，远山层叠，飞檐古寺隐于山峦之间，小玉兔立于山巅岩石，夜空漂浮细碎星光，中式山水卷草纹样，半透明云雾缭绕，金棕红渐变，磨砂颗粒肌理；高对比度，暗调光影，细腻线条颗粒，印刷招贴质感，8K，超精细，平面设计，排版艺术，左上方放标题 “CHINESE TRADITIONAL FESTIVALS”，细衬线体放大处理，标题下方放置 “中秋国庆”，再下方文案 “月照山河 盛世同庆”；画面左下方放置日期 “10.01” 和 “10.08” 以及 “2026”，搭配点缀小字 “MID AUTUMN FESTIVAL NATIONAL DAY”，日期与点缀小字全部衬线体；底部左下角极小号横向排布 “MID AUTUMN FESTIVAL”，底端左侧极小号横向排布 “Oct 1‑ Oct 06,2026”；右下角极小号横向排布 “NATIONAL DAY”，全部文字统一细衬线体，文字位置固定，不扭曲变形
